title: Martin Luther King Day / Zoo open
description: The Montgomery Zoo and Mann Wildlife Learning Museum are OPEN on Martin Luther King, Jr. Day. We look forward to seeing you at the Zoo.

title: Closed Christmas Day Dec 25, opens at 5:30pm for Light Festival
description: The Montgomery Zoo and Mann Wildlife Learning Museum are closed during the Christmas Day holiday, December 25; however, OPEN at 5:30pm for Christmas Lights Festival.

title: Christmas Lights Festival, OPENING NIGHT
description: See the Montgomery Zoo transformed into a Winter Wonderland displaying thousands of sparkling and twinkling lights and festive decorations at Christmas Lights Festival. Take a leisurely stroll, a brisk train ride, or see the lights from atop the Zoofari Skylift Adventure Ride.

title: Christmas Lights Festival
description: See the Montgomery Zoo transformed into a Winter Wonderland displaying thousands of sparkling and twinkling lights and festive decorations at Christmas Lights Festival. Take a leisurely stroll, a brisk train ride, or see the lights from atop the Zoofari Skylift Adventure Ride.

title: Giving Tuesday
description: Giving Tuesday, the Montgomery Zoo invites you to join us in making a difference for wildlife. With your support, we can continue to protect endangered species, provide excellent care for our animals, and inspire the next generation of conservationists.

title: Black Friday, Zoo/Museum OPEN
description: The Montgomery Zoo and Mann Wildlife Learning Museum are OPEN on Black Friday. We look forward to seeing you at the Zoo.

title: Thanksgiving Day, Zoo/Museum CLOSED
description: The Montgomery Zoo and Mann Wildlife Learning Museum will be closed on Thanksgiving Day. From our family to yours, we wish you a wonderful Thanksgiving with family and friends.

title: Annual Members Board Meeting
description: All Montgomery Zoo members are cordially invited to attend the Annual Members Board Meeting to learn more about the Montgomery Zoo and its future and impact on the region, conservation efforts, and its impact throughout the world.

title: Dino Dig Education Program
description: Are you ready to get a little dirty? Then Dino Dig is perfect for you. Our junior explorers get to experience an archaeological dig, discover bones from the past and have a great time while learning about creatures that roamed the earth millions of years ago.

title: Zoo Volunteer Serve Day
description: ZOO SERVE DAY is a single day event where volunteer groups join forces to accomplish several tasks; including landscaping, trimming bushes, planting flowers, raking leaves, painting, and overall prepping the Zoo for upcoming events. It is a great opportunity for groups to serve the Zoo.

title: Veterans Day, November 11, Zoo/Museum OPEN
description: The Montgomery Zoo and Mann Wildlife Learning Museum are open during the Veteran's Day holiday, November 11.

title: Veterans Day Celebration
description: Honoring All Who Served

title: Veterans Appreciation Week
description: During Veteran's Appreciation Week, all veterans, active duty military personnel, and their dependent family members receive a 50% DISCOUNT on REGULAR DAYTIME admission to the Montgomery Zoo and Mann Wildlife Learning Museum. Thank you for your service and dedication to the nation and the world.

title: Creatures of the Night / Family Fun Night Mann Museum Flashlight Tour
description: Creatures of the Night/Mann Museum Flashlight Tour, Education Program and Family Fun, Friday evening, October 24, 5:30pm - 8:30pm. A night featuring a live animal presentation of creepy creatures and a flashlight tour of the Mann Museum, games, live animal presentations, and a whole lots more fun!

title: ZooBrews and Food Festival
description: ZooBrews and Food Festival at the Montgomery Zoo, October 19; Food Trucks, beer and wine, live music, large lawn games, and more
